title: Tinio, Elago frown on Marcos' possible attendance in Singapore F1 event

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio and Gabriela Women’s party Rep. Sarah Elago on Wednesday slammed the possible attendance of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. at the Formula One Singapore Grand Prix, citing rising inflation and concerns about other basic commodities. The lawmakers were asked for comment on Marcos’s possible attendance at the event. Marcos is in Singapore from October 7-11 for a working visit, while the racing competition will be held from October 9-11 at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.
